patch_description: Implements the recommended activation of the dormant `_make_seeds()` multi-start: every structured seed (staggered lattices, corner-anchored, Halton) gets a cheap pipeline (a short refine + one shift pass), the top-2 by solved sum advance to the full refine→shift→refine fixed point, and the final radii come from the exact scipy LP (with fast water-filling fallback + greedy enlarge). This best-of-K selection over diverse seeds is designed to escape the 2.48–2.49 lattice-basin plateau that single-seed pipelines have been stuck on, while keeping total runtime moderate since the expensive stage runs only on two candidates.
